# @tiavision/sinter-alloy

> sinter components that need a script: `<alloy-sortable>` (reorder a list with pointer or keyboard; emits `move`, the page applies it with an optimistic merge). Built for temper (a required peer). Design of the rest (boards, pickers, command palette, long lists, split panes): docs/DESIGN.md.

Setup: `sinter({ libraries: ['@tiavision/sinter-alloy'] })`; `export * as alloy from '@tiavision/sinter-alloy'` in src/sinter.helpers.ts; `export type { Move, SortableText } from '@tiavision/sinter-alloy'` in src/sinter.types.ts; with temper's plugin add `node_modules/@tiavision/sinter-alloy/sinter/components` to `paths` (icons).

- `<alloy-sortable data-sn-with="{ items, keyOf: (x) => x.id, nameOf?: (x) => x.name, label, disabled?, quiet?, text? }" data-sn-on-move="mv = $event.detail; run('save')">` with a fill `<x slot="item">` reading `$slot.item`, `$slot.index` (typed `any`: cast in a let, `data-sn-let="{ f: /** @type {Folder} */ ($slot.item) }"`). It never changes the list: a drop emits `move` = `Move { key, from, to, after, before, via: 'pointer' | 'keyboard' }`.
- Apply a move: the resource has `order="<field>"`; a hidden action `<span hidden id="save" data-sn-put="/api/x/order" data-sn-when="mv" data-sn-body="{ ids: alloy.keysAfter(list, mv, (x) => x.id) }" data-sn-optimistic="merge(list.find((x) => x.id === mv.key), { rank: alloy.between(list, mv, 'rank') })">`. Check the request goes out in a built page: in caley, a `run()` target inside the sidebar's own `data-sn-state` did nothing in the build (it worked in `render()`); placed at page level it works. Not yet explained: docs/DESIGN.md, Q-S1. Items from state: `data-sn-on-move="names = alloy.reorder(names, $event.detail)"`.
- Helpers: `reorder(list, move)`, `keysAfter(list, move, keyOf)`, `between(list, move, field)` (midpoint of the new neighbours' values, ±1 at the ends; equal neighbours: their value), `moved(list, move, keyOf)`.
- Keys: Space/Enter on the handle lifts, ArrowUp/Down/Home/End move, Space/Enter drops, Escape or Tab away cancels; announced in a live region; `text` (SortableText: handle(name), instructions, lifted/moved/dropped(name, position, total), cancelled(name, position)) for other languages.
- Tests: `render()` with the component's HTML as a component and its script in `scripts`; a script's state writes render on the next task (`await settle()`, or a `setTimeout(0)` then `flush()` while a request is held).
